## Shape of the plan

79 rows cover 56 implementation/execution work units, 15 decision/human markers and eight closeout work units. Thirteen work units are skeletons because they need actual external inputs or authority; they have no Run line. The nine-role full tail includes the fresh acceptance gate.

The order is: guarded bootstrap → exact ADR/method admission → native task/grade/budget/treatment/receipt machinery → early offline examples → complete numerical/protocol admission → bounded backend preflight → actual useful-task/operational proofs → staged pilot/parity/confirmation → outside/formative evaluation → scoped publication/manual follow-up → independent closeout and docs.

The primary implementation risks have explicit owner boundaries: shared first-valid grading; Account-derived caps and physical incurred use; retained view to actual provider bytes; planned-slot analysis; native typed reference closure; distinct numerical targets and policy parity. No second runner, codec, result authority or estimator fallback is silently introduced.

## Independent review and repairs

Two fresh-context reviewers examined the frozen specification, plan/contracts and invariants. They found scoped issues, not a need to redesign the program:

| Finding | Repair |
|---|---|
| A real quote depended on inputs scheduled after its engineering ticket | Quote ticket now implements construction/validation with fixtures; human/stage gates bind actual numeric quotes |
| Backend proof was demanded before a route existed to earn it | Added GATE-G18 and non-dispatchable R5.42a preflight before separate S1/S4 authorization |
| Mandatory client evidence could disappear with optional plugin nonselection | Selected-client requests/updates/callback/failure proof moved to the mandatory recipe owner |
| Compound requirements lacked exact later contributors | Explicit recipient, grading, methods, optional exercise and signature evidence links added |
| Formative closure could precede later follow-up/deletion | G205/G208 retain later evidence; contacts and raw observations have the correct deletion/withdrawal obligation |
| Method dossier counted five remaining amendment rows instead of four | Corrected and named the four rows; all seven source amendments remain assigned |

[Initial partition review](2026-10-30_evidence-partition-review-initial.md), [partition rereview — clean](2026-10-30_evidence-partition-rereview.md), [initial coverage review](2026-10-30_evidence-coverage-review-initial.md). [Coverage rereview — clean](2026-10-30_evidence-coverage-rereview.md). All reported findings are closed at the planning/contract level; no future execution proof is implied. Initial reports retain their original pre-repair filenames/counts as historical review evidence.

## Deliberate tradeoffs

The default chain preserves the whole scientific and adoption program, including manual 30/90-day observations and later deletion. It is not one uninterrupted autonomous run. Early useful-task publication can be explicitly separated while retaining the study; it is never inferred from fixtures or missing evidence.

Context/line estimates are split triggers, not implementation-time promises. The widest consumer/closure tickets must measure the actual worker window and stay within the stated ≤40% total. The plan remains revisable by a scoped reviewed split before execution.
